description: The Mule is a single-track, sprung cargo trailer for city trips and world tours. The lightweight CrMo steel frame offers stable handling with a payload of up to 38 kg (80-100 liters). The adjustable suspension adapts to the terrain and weight. Thanks to the shaft joint drawbar, the connection remains stable and smooth-running. The Mule can be customized with optional accessories such as a stand, inner bag and rain cover. The internal dimensions in mm (LxWxH) are: 730(530) x 400(285) x 160. You will find the shortest dimension in brackets. Optional accessories such as coupling, stand, mudguard or bag can be purchased separately.
